nodes.label: Monorepo Build Configuration
nodes.rationale: minimumReleaseAge: 0 disables age check. allowBuilds whitelist permits postinstall scripts for Prisma and unrs-resolver, otherwise blocked by pnpm strict build policy.

nodes.label: File Document Icon
nodes.rationale: 16x16 SVG, gray monochrome document icon with corner fold and horizontal lines representing text. Used as generic file/document indicator in UI.

nodes.label: Globe Icon
nodes.rationale: 16x16 SVG, gray wireframe globe with orbital elliptical lines. Likely used for internationalization, network, or worldwide/global features.

nodes.label: Agent File Auto-Generation Rule
nodes.rationale: next dev writes and re-adds this block via node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js. Removing from a diff recreates the uncommitted change; committing keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Warning
nodes.rationale: next dev auto-generates this block via generate-agent-files.js. Warns AI agents that this Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data. Directs to node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for correct APIs.

nodes.label: Next.js Logotype
nodes.rationale: 394x80 SVG, black Next.js wordmark logotype. Brand asset for Next.js framework identity.

nodes.label: Vercel Triangle Logo
nodes.rationale: 1155x1000 SVG, white upward-pointing triangle on transparent background. Vercel deployment platform brand logo.
